cards: This is the Tilde Card: a business card you print yourself, in a design you put together. Scan its code and your website opens. Tap it and the phone gets whatever you wrote to the NFC sticker inside: your link, or your whole contact card if it fits. Pick a front, a back and your colors: the combinations are countless, and the cards here are a few examples.
fobs: These are Tilde fobs: coins and tags for your keys, with an NFC sticker inside. Tap one with a phone and it opens whatever’s on the sticker: a link, your contact card, your Wi-Fi. The tags have a QR code too. The box holds a few; here’s every shape, color and icon.
uses: One tag, one job. Everything in these boxes is a tag with an NFC sticker inside. Tap it with a phone and it does one thing: gets your family’s number ready to call, shares your contact, joins the Wi-Fi. Here are the eight jobs in our boxes, what each does on an iPhone and on Android, and how to make your own.
hub: Tilde is a business card for a tap or a scan. On your Android phone, it’s an app: hold your phone to someone else’s and they get your contact card, your website or your WhatsApp. To hand out, it’s a card or a tag you print yourself, with a QR code and an NFC sticker inside.
